evidence.title: Africa Data Centres breaks ground for Samrand facility expansion
evidence.excerpt: Africa Data Centres reports that construction of the first phase of its Samrand expansion started on 30 August 2022 and was planned to deliver 20 MW of IT load across eight data halls.
